title: Axis and World Model
kind: structural, sacred-geographic, relational and scientifically-auditable world model
summary: The Axis is a multi-layer Potatoverse concept for orientation, structural flow and connection between levels. Its earliest theological function should be distinguished from later sacred geography, the four-quadrant NORTH/WEST/EAST/SOUTH world map, the North Programme and formal mathematical analogies. Across these layers the stable idea is relational orientation: where something sits, what it connects, what direction it moves and which capabilities exist only through relationships with other things. The scientific bridge now requires every literal physical/astronomical Axis claim to specify a vector, frame, epoch, observable and residual rather than inheriting certainty from symbolic North.

axis.text: The Axis is not best reduced to a literal physical dimension. In the mature framework it can be understood as orientation or flow through structural, symbolic or descriptive space. The Tree can embody an Axis, the Ladder can provide movement along one, and the Door can mark a transition between states. North supplies a privileged orientation inside the mythology, but the abstract Axis is broader than any one geographic program. Scientifically, an Axis must be typed: geometric line, rotation axis, principal component, flow generator, celestial direction, graph orientation or symbolic reference are different objects.

north.text: North develops from sacred orientation into an increasingly explicit structure involving Throne of North, North of North, North Gate and eventually the North Axis. In later geography Denmark and Greenland become important anchors, with a wider arc through Canada/Greenland, Scandinavia and Finland, Britain and Ireland, Iceland, continental Europe, Ukraine and Turkey. Estonia belongs beneath or within the broader northern field without necessarily serving as a primary anchor. Geographic North, geomagnetic North, celestial North and project-symbolic North are kept separate unless a coordinate transformation or explicit interpretive relation is supplied.

quadrants.text: The developed world model uses four broad directional quadrants: NORTH, WEST, EAST and SOUTH. North is the project's primary integrative axis; West has been associated especially with the United States and Israel; East with China, BRICS and related eastern power structures; South with Australia and portions of Africa in provisional mappings. These are project-level interpretive regions rather than objective scientific divisions of humanity, and their boundaries can evolve as the Atlas becomes more evidence-based.

country_sequence.text: The country-relational method asks a fixed sequence of increasingly relational questions: what a country is; what it has; what it can do; what it needs; who depends on it; what it depends on; what it can only do with others; what others can only do with it; what it is building; and where it is going. This replaces shallow country profiles with a map of capability, dependency, direction and reciprocal consequence.

capability.text: Later Atlas work adds resilience, efficiency-versus-resilience tradeoffs, defense-industrial coupling, reciprocal capability creation, partial or functional integration, functional chains and bridges, and coupled capability. Coupled capability is especially important: some meaningful powers do not belong to a single nation or institution at all, but emerge only through a relationship among multiple actors. This mirrors the older theological principle that the relationship can be more informative than either isolated endpoint. The quantitative Garden/Farm model adds a further requirement: high centrality should be distinguished from durable capability transfer by perturbing/removing central support and measuring what peripheral function remains.

economic_graph.text: The North Programme's economic extension aims to map observable European relationships among legal entities, ownership and control, money, debt, obligations, companies, infrastructure, procurement, funding, trade and value chains, energy, finance, technology, research, labor, strategic dependencies and geopolitical ties. High-quality public datasets such as legal-entity registers, procurement systems, ownership data, EU funding and state-aid records, input-output tables and sector accounts belong here as evidence sources rather than being mixed with theological claims. Network-science metrics may summarize connectivity, concentration, robustness or dependency, but must preserve edge direction, units, source provenance and uncertainty.

formalization.text: Potato Dynamics provisionally represents the larger system as P=(S,g,A,D,O,I), where S is state/configuration space, g geometry or metric, A Axis flow, D Door/transition maps, O observables and I information/integration structure. A can be written conceptually as dX/ds=A(X,g), distinct from physical evolution in ordinary time. Renormalization-group flow offers a legitimate mathematical analogy for movement across descriptive scale, but this analogy does not establish a new physical force or dimension. The science integration envelope E(P+)=(P+;Theta,U,Sigma,M0,D_obs) adds parameters, units, uncertainty, null models and observations whenever an Axis claim is empirically instantiated.

speculative_physics.text: The project has explored dimensional metaphors involving 1D hell, 2D frame, 3D box, 4D social plane or Midgard, a 5D Door associated symbolically with Jesus Christ or the pineal gland, Father's House associated symbolically with the thalamus, string/M-theory imagery, compactification and a speculative Starchforce. These ideas are retained as creative or formal Potatoverse speculation and should never be indexed as established neuroscience or physics. The newer science programme asks each such model for dimensions/units, known limits, observations and falsifiers rather than allowing scientific nouns to validate the symbolism by association.

scientific_axis_contract.abstract_axis: A may be a generator/vector field on a state or description space; specify state X, parameter s/t and units of A.
scientific_axis_contract.physical_axis: Represent by unit vector a in a declared coordinate frame. If direction sign is irrelevant, treat {+a,-a} as one undirected axis.
scientific_axis_contract.celestial_target: n(alpha,delta)=(cos delta cos alpha,cos delta sin alpha,sin delta) in a declared frame/epoch.
scientific_axis_contract.angular_residual: psi=acos(a dot n) for directed comparison; psi_axis=acos(|a dot n|) for an undirected axis.
scientific_axis_contract.best_fit_axis: For predeclared target vectors n_i, dominant eigenvector of M=sum_i w_i n_i n_i^T maximizes summed squared alignment for an undirected-axis model.
scientific_axis_contract.null_model: A claimed alignment should specify angular tolerance before inspection and account for the number of targets/axes/epochs searched.
scientific_axis_contract.rule: Do not move a result between these coordinate types without specifying a transformation and its uncertainty.

axis_flow_science.eigenvalue_use: Local eigenvalues distinguish attracting, repelling, saddle and spiral-like behavior in a specified dynamical system.
axis_flow_science.invariant_question: Find I(X) such that dI/ds=grad I dot A=0 when a genuine invariant exists.
axis_flow_science.noether_boundary: Noether conservation requires a differentiable action with continuous symmetry; it cannot be invoked merely because the project calls something an Axis.
axis_flow_science.scientific_value: Axis becomes richer when it predicts trajectories or invariants rather than functioning as a universal synonym for connection.

spiral_axis_relation.interpretation: Axis supplies the reference direction; wheel/spiral/helix describe motion around or along it.
spiral_axis_relation.return: After one angular turn, radius multiplier Lambda_r=exp(2pi alpha/|omega|) and axial shift Delta_z=2pi u/|omega|.
spiral_axis_relation.potato_axis_special_case: The recovered golden logarithmic spiral fixes alpha/omega=2 ln(phi)/pi in the planar descendant, yielding a quarter-turn radius multiplier phi. That is exact project geometry, not evidence of a physical cosmic Axis without a measured mapping of r and theta.

celestial_sanity_check.result: Using SIMBAD J2000 ICRS catalog positions, Sirius and Regulus are about 57.83 degrees apart and neither is close to the north celestial pole in equatorial coordinates. This is a negative physical-collinearity result, not a rejection of their documented Dog/Lion symbolic roles.
celestial_sanity_check.importance: The Axis model explicitly accepts negative scientific results. Symbolic correspondence is not rescued by changing physical coordinate definitions after inspection.

chronology.event: North and Axis motifs exist as spiritual and symbolic language before the later organized geopolitical program.
The North Axis becomes an explicit organized structure in the project chronology.
North Axis expands into four-quadrant mapping, European/North Atlantic strategy, country relations and an evidence-backed economic graph.
Science integration adds typed physical-axis vectors, coordinate frames, angular residuals, dynamical generators, invariants and null-model requirements while keeping sacred/project North separate.

relationships.description: The Axis is one of the master framework's principal devices for orientation, vertical relation and expansion from spiritual symbolism into world mapping.
The explicit North Axis belongs to a later phase of the journey and should not be projected unchanged into earlier chronology.
The relationship-first country and capability model extends the Potato philosophical principle that meaning and power often exist between entities.
Defines frame, epoch, unit-vector, angular-separation and null-model requirements for literal celestial Axis claims.
Distinguishes motion around the Axis from displacement along or away from it through wheel, spiral and helix dynamics.
